name: Superior Plus Propane
notes: Researched from public superiorpluspropane.com pages and the mySuperior sign-in page (mysuperioraccountlogin.com) only; never signed in or registered. The sign-in page shows Log In, Remember me? and a 'Reset or Forgot Password' link; the sign-in input's placeholder is Email Address (observed in the page source), so auth.identifier is email. Registration ('Existing customer new to the portal? Register Here!') works with an email address alone or account number plus email. Auto Pay is pre-authorized recurring monthly payment by credit card or bank transfer; withdrawals run on the 1st or 15th (Propane FAQ) and the date is changed by calling 1-855-804-FUEL. No guest payment is mentioned publicly (family default kept). Accepted cards: Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Discover, debit. No fees are published. Closing an account is done by email or by calling 1-855-804-FUEL. Independent review 2026-10-09: set auth.identifier email from the observed placeholder; Auto Pay days 1/15 and card brands from the Propane FAQ; removed the unsupported claim that Auto Pay can be stopped or re-dated in mySuperior; budget help now notes online enrollment in mySuperior (Budget Payment Plan page) and attributes the 11+1 payment structure to the FAQ.

help.title: Pay your bill
paragraphs: Pay online in the mySuperior portal with a one-time payment, or set up Auto Pay. Superior accepts Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover and debit cards, as well as checks, eChecks and electronic funds transfers.
Bills arrive by mail unless you choose Paperless Statements. For help with payments call 855-804-FUEL (855-804-3835).

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay sets up pre-authorized recurring monthly payments from a Visa, Mastercard or Discover card or from a bank account, so you avoid writing checks and paying late fees. Withdrawals happen on the 1st or the 15th of the month.

To change your withdrawal date, call 1-855-804-FUEL (3835). To update the card or bank details used for pre-authorized payments, log in to mySuperior or call 800-210-5618 to reach your local customer service center.
steps: Choose a credit card or bank account.

help.title: Paperless Statements
paragraphs: Paper bills are the default. Sign up for Paperless Statements in the mySuperior portal to stop mailed bills; invoice and statement PDFs stay available to download at any time.

help.title: Budget Payment Plan
paragraphs: The Budget Payment Plan spreads your heating cost over 12 months. Superior's FAQ describes it as 11 equal monthly payments, with the 12th settling whatever remains on the account. It covers fuel, delivery fees and taxes, but not service work, other fees or tank rent.

Superior reviews your plan during the year and adjusts the payment if your usage changes. You can enroll at any time in mySuperior; the plan starts the following month. Missing monthly payments can end the plan.
steps: Select ENROLL and review your monthly payment and payment method.

help.title: Closing your account or moving
paragraphs: To close your account or move, email Superior Plus Propane or call 1-855-804-FUEL (3835). Your local customer service center will walk you through the process.

extra.intent: Find the phone number Superior Plus Propane lists for updating the credit card or bank details used for pre-authorized payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Superior Plus Propane's help pages, find how many equal monthly payments the Budget Payment Plan has before the final settling payment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: 11 equal monthly payments; the 12th settles the remainder.
